channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Black holes keep tearing these stars apart, but they survive
item.description: Astronomers have discovered stars that repeatedly pass close to supermassive black holes, surviving each encounter while emitting new bursts of light.

item.title: This shark can live 400 years. Its eyes barely seem to age
item.description: Greenland sharks may live up to 400 years without typical age-related retinal decline. Researchers found healthy eye tissue in these long-lived sharks.

item.title: JWST reveals early galaxies may be four times more massive than estimated
item.description: Observations from JWST indicate that massive early galaxies contain more small, faint stars than previously thought, potentially increasing their total mass significantly.

item.title: Speaking multiple languages may keep brains up to 13 years younger
item.description: Research suggests that multilingual individuals may experience slower brain aging, with those speaking four languages showing brains about 13 years younger in appearance.
